business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Virgin Polyethylene and Polypropylene Granules

stage_1.expense_line_item: Name clearance (certificado de homonimia) consultation on RUES
stage_1.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the chosen domicile (e.g., Bogotá)
stage_1.legal_fee_basis: Chamber statutory tariff for registry services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, arts. 98-110, 372-373, 378, 400; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office, acting through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (registered in the Registro Mercantil; Escritura Pública required for real estate or commercial establishment contributions)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an S.A.S.; capital may be nominal (e.g. COP 1 or USD 1). Paid-in capital may be deferred in accordance with the bylaws. No bank escrow account is mandated by law; escrow is only triggered by contract or if contributions require fiduciary backing. Contributions of real estate or a commercial establishment must be formalized by public deed and registered.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE FOUNDING BOARD OF SHAREHOLDERS OF [SAS NAME]. Having subscribed the entire share capital and adopted the bylaws: Resolved, 1) the subscription and issuance of fully paid or duly deferred shares is approved in accordance with the capital contribution table; 2) the registered office is established at [City/Address], Colombia, and the legal representative is authorized to formalize the lease or deed; 3) the following officers are appointed: Manager and Legal Representative [Name], with broad powers; Deputy Manager [Name]; and Secretary/Treasurer [Name], each to exercise statutory and corporate powers; 4) the officers are instructed to complete commercial registry, tax registration, and applicable industrial/environmental licenses. Approved unanimously. Certified by the Secretary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio via RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a homonimia/name availability application for the proposed S.A.S. legal name. Verify that no identical or confusingly similar registered name exists. Reserve the exact corporate name for subsequent registration.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name
Shareholder identification documents
Application form for name availability certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged as similar, file a corrected application with two alternative names and address any registry observations before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarial Authentication of the Incorporation Document
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Documento Privado de Constitución under Ley 1258 de 2008. Include the corporate purpose covering ISIC 4669 wholesale distribution of virgin polyethylene and polypropylene granules, capital structure, registered office, governance rules, and officer powers. Have all shareholders or their attorneys sign; authenticate signatures before the notary.
required_dossiers: Draft S.A.S. incorporation document and bylaws
Name availability certificate
Shareholder identification and NIT or residence certificates
Power of attorney if any shareholder acts through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial observations must be corrected by amending the objectionable clauses; re-authenticate the corrected document and re-submit for notarial approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Inscription with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed and authenticated incorporation document, completed Formulario Único de Registro (FUR), pre-RUT information, and payment of registry fees. Upon successful registration, the Chamber issues the NIT and the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal.
required_dossiers: Incorporation document with authenticated signatures
Formulario Único de Registro (FUR)
Pre-RUT form
Name availability certificate
Proof of payment of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry raises legal objections, respond to the request within the statutory term, file corrected clauses, and request re-inscription; administrative reconsideration remedies remain available under Colombian commercial law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the NIT is assigned, update the RUT online through the DIAN portal. Confirm the principal activity as ISIC 4669, VAT and income tax responsibilities, and the authorized foreign trade operations. Obtain the electronic invoicing system authorization and digital signature certificate where applicable.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
NIT and RUT preliminary record
Identification document of the legal representative
Proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN issues an inconsistency notice, file an RUT correction through the 'Actualización del RUT' service, correct tax classification data, and request immediate re-validation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Libro de Actas, Libro de Registro de Accionistas, and statutory account ledgers. Submit them to the Chamber for numbering, sealing, and legalization. Retain the legalized books at the registered office for inspection and corporate governance use.
required_dossiers: Corporate minute book in physical or RUP accredited format
Shareholder registry book
Certificate of existence and legal representation
Copy of the officer appointment resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber rejects the books for formatting deficiencies, re-bind and re-paginate the volumes, obtain a new legalization stamp, and pay the corresponding re-inspection fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Enrollment and Municipal Use-of-Soil Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: PILA system, ARL insurance company, and municipal planning or land-use office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer with the social security system through PILA and affiliate the legal representative/employees with an ARL for occupational risk coverage. Notify the local planning office of the warehousing and commercial activity to confirm land-use conformity for storage and distribution of polymer granules.
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT
Certificate of existence and legal representation
Identification of the employer and workers
Lease contract or property title with address
Operating activity description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal office issues a non-conformity finding, file a written administrative reconsideration, propose alternate restricted storage conditions, or adjust the operational plan to match the permitted land use.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for market surveillance; municipal planning/land-use office and Cámara de Comercio for commercial establishment registration no separate statutory industrial license is required for wholesale distribution
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Establecimiento de Comercio and Certificado de Uso de Suelo for Warehousing and Wholesale Distribution of Petrochemical Polymer Granules

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible / Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) / Secretaría Distrital o Municipal de Ambiente
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental registration or declaration; full EIA report not required for storage and wholesale distribution of virgin polyethylene and polypropylene granules unless storage capacity or physical transformation triggers projects requiring licensing under Decreto 1076 de 2015
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Air quality compliance with Resolución 2254 de 2017 (annual PM10 50 µg/m³, PM2.5 25 µg/m³); no process water discharge expected; stormwater and spill-water from polymer storage must meet discharge limits of Resolución 0631 de 2015; polymer dust, spills, and off-spec pellets must be handled as solid waste under Decreto 4741 de 2005 and Ley 1252 de 2008.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) after inspection covering extinguishers, hydrant access, and storage spacing; structural load and seismic compliance per Reglamento Colombiano de Construcción Sismo Resistente NSR-10; occupational workplace clearance through the ARL and Ministry of Labour standards under Resolución 2400 de 1979, including dust control, emergency evacuation, and safe handling procedures for bulk polymer pellets.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Colombian National Tax and Customs Directorate. Institutional web portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; electronic taxpayer platform (MUISOCA) for RUT registration, NIT issuance, and e-invoicing: https://muisca.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Every Colombian entity or foreign entity with Colombian tax obligations must enrol in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) and obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), which serves as both the income tax ID and the VAT ID. For a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.): (1) incorporate the S.A.S. by private deed filed with the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio), which simultaneously processes the initial RUT opening; (2) complete the electronic RUT pre-registration via the MUISOCA platform or at a DIAN office, stating the primary ISIC activity 4669 and the taxpayer's exporter status; (3) obtain the NIT and the electronic RUT certificate. A non-resident foreign entity without a permanent establishment that still has Colombian VAT obligations (e.g., taxable digital services rendered to Colombian residents, or acting as a consignor/seller where the local buyer cannot self-invoice) must register through a general attorney-in-fact in Colombia holding a notarized and authenticated power of attorney; DIAN then assigns a foreign-entity NIT and records the status 'responsable del IVA' in the RUT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A Colombian S.A.S. is a resident legal entity automatically taxed at entity level on its worldwide income under the general corporate income tax regime (35% statutory rate for tax year 2025, plus the 10% surcharge applicable only to certain extractive/energy sectors, which does not apply to petrochemical wholesale trading). Pass-through treatment is not available; there is no Colombian federal/state dual taxation and no preferential entity classification for a standard S.A.S.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombian law does not provide a US-style check-the-box election for domestic business entities. A Colombian S.A.S. is mandatorily an income tax payer and VAT responsible party. Available statutory elections: (i) the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (SIMPLE) election under Estatuto Tributario Articles 903-916, available to eligible small taxpayers (legal entities with annual gross income up to approximately COP 3,500 million), which consolidates income tax, VAT, ICA and other taxes into a progressive rate on gross income; (ii) the election by a non-resident provider of digital services to register with DIAN and collect VAT on services supplied to Colombian consumers; (iii) the election by a foreign entity to maintain a branch (establecimiento permanente) and file under a Colombian NIT through a resident legal representative; (iv) the exporter's election to apply the proportional VAT-credit methodology for the refund of VAT borne on export inputs; (v) no hybrid-mismatch election exists: Colombia's anti-hybrid rules introduced by Law 2277 of 2022 operate automatically to disallow double deductions and to include the corresponding income. A Zona Franca (free trade zone) regime, if elected, provides a reduced 20% CIT rate and VAT exclusion on eligible transactions, but the input file does not place the S.A.S. in a Zona Franca.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT / IVA - Impuesto sobre el Valor Agregado), Title V of the Estatuto Tributario, regulated by Decree 1625 of 2016 and DIAN rulings. Colombia applies the destination principle; the VAT is a single-stage national tax with creditable input VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 (no de minimis economic turnover threshold). Under Article 437 and related provisions of the Estatuto Tributario, any person or legal entity engaged in the sale of goods or rendering of taxable services in Colombian territory, or which imports goods, is mandatorily a VAT responsible party subject to RUT registration from the first taxable transaction. A wholesale S.A.S. trader cannot elect out of the general VAT system; however, an eligible micro-business may instead be covered by the SIMPLE regime, which charges a consolidated rate that includes a VAT component. For imports of polyethylene/polypropylene granules, DIAN assesses VAT at customs (19%) at the time of importation, regardless of the importer's registration status.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia has a mandatory electronic invoicing regime (facturación electrónica) applicable to all VAT responsible persons. Invoices must be issued as 'factura electrónica de venta' in XML (UBL 2.1) through DIAN-authorized technology providers using DIAN's web services (API) integrated with the MUISOCA platform. Each invoice must contain a unique CUFE or CUDS code (digital stamp/QR hash) and must be transmitted instantaneously to DIAN; the invoice is legally valid only after the platform returns the validation envelope (aceptación). The electronic invoice must be delivered to the buyer, and all transactions must be reported to DIAN in near real time. For taxpayers classified as high fiscal risk or engaging in designated wholesale fuels/trading activities, DIAN Resolution 000165 of 2023 and related rules impose 'validación previa' - a real-time fiscal clearance that requires DIAN's approval of the invoice before the transaction can be released to the buyer. Documentation-support equivalents ('documento equivalente electrónico') are required for purchases from persons not obliged to invoice.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods, including virgin polyethylene and polypropylene granules, are excluded from VAT (zero-rated) under Estatuto Tributario Article 481 numeral 1. The zero-rating applies only where: (1) the seller is registered in the RUT with the exporter status; (2) the sale is effected as a true customs export from Colombia, evidenced by an accepted electronic export declaration; (3) the goods physically leave the Colombian customs territory; and (4) the export proceeds are channelled through the Colombian foreign exchange market. The S.A.S. must issue an electronic export invoice showing IVA 0%, file the periodic VAT return, and may credit the VAT borne on purchase of the granules and related export costs (direct cost/proportional method). A VAT refund or offset (devolución y/o compensación) is available for the creditable balance exceeding the tax charged in the period. Certain services wholly rendered to non-residents and related to foreign territory can also be zero-rated under Article 481 numerals 3 to 7, but goods exports are the operative category for ISIC 4669 wholesale trading.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic customs export declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX) filed and accepted through DIAN's trade platform (SIIGA/MUISCOA), including the corresponding authorization number and export registration code
Electronic export invoice (factura electrónica de venta de exportación) with IVA 0%, containing the CUFE code, ISIC 4669 description, and the identification (NIT) of both seller and foreign buyer
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing dispatch of the physical goods from Colombian customs territory
Commercial contract or purchase order showing the exported quantity, unit price, and Incoterms terms
Inward Remittance Certificate (certificado de canalización de divisas) issued by an authorised Colombian bank intermediary, proving collection of the foreign currency
Certificate of origin (when the export documentary credit requires it), together with the warehouse/loading receipts and any cargo manifest

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (central bank) and Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (financial supervisor). Foreign-exchange regulation is governed by Law 9 of 1991, Banco de la República Resolution 8 of 2000, the DCIN-83 regulatory handbook, and the DIAN customs framework; all conversions and cross-border payments must be channeled through duly authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario, IMCs) and declared on Formulario No. 5 (Declaración de Cambio).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia applies a managed-float regime with full convertibility on the free exchange market for current-account transactions and for capital-account flows that are registered with Banco de la República. Current-account convertibility is unrestricted in principle, but every conversion must be executed through an IMC and declared on Formulario No. 5; foreign direct investment (equity into an S.A.S.) enters under Segment 45 (International Investments) and must be registered without prior exchange-control authorization. Dividend and capital-repatriation remittances are permitted after registration and after certification that Colombian corporate tax and the 10% dividend-withholding levy (when applicable) have been settled. The operative hurdles are documentary and procedural: mis-coded declarations, late Form 5 filings or unregistered shareholdings trigger sanctions under the exchange-control regime, but the regime does not impose quantitative caps or discretionary rationing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Resolution 8 of 2000 (as amended), 100% of merchandise export proceeds must be channeled through the official exchange market by sale to an IMC or credit to a local foreign-currency account within the statutory period, generally six (6) months from the date of the transport document for non-South American destinations, with shorter periods for Andean-region trade; no fixed surrender ratio exists because conversion occurs at the free-market rate. Proceeds must be matched to the corresponding export customs declaration (Declaración de Exportación) within the same window. For the petrochemical trading S.A.S., all documentary-credit (LC) and open-account export collections must be received via SWIFT MT103 into the Colombian account and declared under Formulario No. 5 within the channeling term; failure to channel within the deadline constitutes the exchange-control violation of non-canalización and attracts fines and DIAN enforcement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational COP Current Account and Foreign-Currency USD Account (designated IMC)
Operational COP Current Account and USD Account; strong LC issuance desk
Operational COP Current Account and Foreign-Currency Account
Operational COP Current Account and USD Trade-Finance Account
Operational COP Current Account and USD Account with North-American correspondent network
Operational COP Current Account and USD Trade-Finance Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Restricted / Low viability. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise Business, Payoneer, Mercury) are not registered Colombian IMCs and cannot lawfully serve as the primary treasury hub because exchange-control rules oblige all import, export and capital flows to be channeled through an IMC and declared on Formulario No. 5. An offshore EMI account is only tolerable as a non-native receive-only auxiliary wallet for minor receivable collections, and its use for supplier settlements or export collections creates channeling breaches, DIAN customs reconciliation problems and enhanced UBO/AML risk. For this Colombian S.A.S., on-boarding at a tier-1 local bank is the only compliant clearing path
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: High physical-presence mandate. The legal representative (and, in practice, the non-resident beneficial owner holding 25% or more) must normally appear in person at a Colombian branch for a biometric KYC interview and signature-verification session. Remote opening is not available as a full substitute for a non-resident-owned commercial company; at most, banks accept a video-call preliminary review followed by physical presentation of apostilled corporate documents and a sworn Spanish translation of powers of attorney (poder). A non-resident shareholder may appoint an apoderado with a notarized, apostilled and translated power of attorney registered with the local Chamber of Commerce, but the Colombian legal representative must still complete one in-person interview before issuance of account credentials. SFC AML rules (Circular Básica Jurídica, Part I, Title IV) further require a UBO declaration identifying direct and indirect beneficial owners above 10%.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owner in an offshore or low-tax jurisdiction controlling more than 25% of the S.A.S. through a multi-layer holding chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing and register of directors for each holding entity; complete corporate chart with exact ownership percentages; tax-residency certificates for all UBOs; passport and proof of address; sworn statement of legitimate source of funds; written commercial rationale for the Colombian petrochemical distribution entity; certified UBO declaration per Circular Básica Jurídica Part I Title IV; notarized minutes of the shareholders' meeting resolving the account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Petrochemical wholesale activity classified as Medium-Risk Enhanced with high-value, fast-rotating inventory and payment timing mismatches between supplier LCs and customer collections.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete trade file for the principal flows: master purchase and sale agreements, import LC copies (MT700/MT707), commercial invoices, bills of lading, warehouse receipts and terminal storage agreements, DIAN customs import declarations, transport and cargo insurance policies, ISO/quality certifications, documented order-to-cash procedure and counterparty screening policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large USD-denominated inflows and outflows inconsistent with COP operating revenue and local market activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Currency-specific cash-flow forecast for 12 months; executed master agreement with the main overseas supplier; annual transfer-pricing (precios de transferencia) study evidencing arm's-length margins; operational plan documenting the resale chain; monthly bank-statement reconciliation model; letter to the compliance officer explaining the USD basis of LC-based procurement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Substantial equity capital injection immediately after incorporation without a clearly demonstrated business value chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholders' minutes perfecting the contribution; incoming SWIFT MT103 highlight copy tagged 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / APORTE DE CAPITAL'; copy of the Formulario No. 5 Segment 45 declaration filed by the IMC; proof of registration of the foreign investment with Banco de la República within the statutory deadline; statutory audit engagement letter and description of intended fund allocation (inventory prepayment, LCs, working capital).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing requires a SWIFT MT103 from the non-resident parent or shareholder to the S.A.S.'s COP or USD account at the chosen IMC, with Field 70 Remittance Information stating 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / APORTE DE CAPITAL SEGUN ACTA No. X — INVERSION EXTRANJERA DIRECTA' and Field 72 stating 'FORM 5 SEGMENT 45 — REGISTRO BANCO DE LA REPUBLICA'. Simultaneously with the credit or conversion, the IMC files the Formulario No. 5 (Declaración de Cambio, Segment 45 – International Investments, Concept 4501: subscription of shares and capital contributions), which perfects the foreign-investment registration. Backup documentation includes the share-issuance minutes, updated company bylaws, RUT and NIT, good-standing certificates, and the UBO forms. The foreign investment must be registered with Banco de la República within two (2) calendar months after perfection of the contribution; no prior exchange-control license is required for equity, but the ex-post registration is mandatory and the State reserves the right to deny channeling if the underlying shareholder is not identified.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier settlements for bulk polyethylene and polypropylene imports are executed via (i) direct SWIFT MT103 transfers for open-account trade, or (ii) Irrevocable Documentary Letters of Credit issued by the Colombian IMC (MT700 issue, MT707 amendments, MT202/MT202 COV cover reimbursements) under UCP600 and URR725. Every disbursement requires a Formulario No. 5 declaration with the IMC on the channeling date using Segment 42 (Imports of Goods, Concept 4201 for payments with own resources or 4202 where supplier financing is used), supported by the proforma/supplier invoice, the DIAN import customs declaration (Declaración Andina), and the transport document. Advance payments for imports require a secured mechanism (LC or guarantee letter issued by a bank, per Resolution 8 of 2000) and strict reconciliation with the final customs declaration. For transshipment or re-export flows, back-to-back LCs, combined-transport bills of lading and temporary-import regimes (importación temporal) are the recommended rails.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP spot and cash-settled outright forwards (non-deliverable forward structure) contracted with an authorized IMC under an ISDA or local master agreement, limited to visible underlying trade exposures
USD/COP cross-currency swaps on notional amounts matched to financed trade receivables or supplier payables
USD call / COP put OTC currency options for LC-based purchase-price protection (options premium settled in COP)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/COP used to hedge LC payables and export-receivable conversion risk without requiring physical delivery at maturity
Embedded trade hedges in LCs, including FX-trigger price adjustment clauses and back-to-back currency alignment mechanisms (operational hedges)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social principal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers arrears surcharge, extinction of commercial registration if prolonged, and prohibition on legal operation; administrative strike-off of the registro mercantil may follow after two consecutive unfiled years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Estados Financieros Anuales (financial statements approved by shareholders)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social principal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 for the fiscal year ended December 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file results in inability to renew the Matrícula Mercantil, monetary fines under commercial code, and potential closure of the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Beneficiario Final (RUB update and annual confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by June 30, subject to current DIAN calendar or calendar-extension resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance carries monetary sanctions and prevents issuance of clean tax compliance certificates (PAC), potentially blocking import and public procurement activities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Asamblea General de Accionistas – approval of annual financial statements and distribution of earnings
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate books – minutes filed with the Cámara de Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be held no later than March 31, with the approved minutes included in the April 30 financial statements filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unapproved financial statements cause ineffective filing; penalty interest for late approval and inability to register board changes or capital increases.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is mandatory for entities with gross assets, gross revenues, or share capital exceeding 5,000 current minimum monthly legal wages (SMLMV); approximately COP 5.5 billion as of 2024. Also mandatory for SAS that by law or by the shareholders' agreement require a revisor fiscal.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Group 1 entities apply full IFRS (NIIF/ NIC) as incorporated by Law 1314 of 2009 and related DIAN regulations; small- and medium-sized entities apply NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, the company must review and update the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) with DIAN. Share transfers, changes in voting control, or changes in direct/indirect ownership must be reported within the statutory time frame following the corporate event. If no changes occur, a confirmation or null update is still required annually to keep the register accurate.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas
Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva (if applicable)
Libro de Estados Financieros (where required by size)
Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (internal support to DIAN RUB)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $2,500-$7,500 per year depending on revenues and complexity of the petrochemical wholesale operations

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for wholesale distribution; standard deductions for costs of polymer goods, freight, storage, salaries, financing, and tax depreciation under Estatuto Tributario (ET) Art. 107; any applicable 40% accelerated deduction for fixed productive assets if eligible, but no material sector exemption for petrochemical trading.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 110 (Declaración de renta y complementarios) filed via DIAN electronic portal (SIE/MUISCA)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 11 months after fiscal year-end (calendar year); DIAN assigns specific deadlines by NIT last digit, generally August 9 to October 10 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number of the S.A.S. plus year of filing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Colombian legal representative must sign with certified digital certificate; foreign shareholders do not appear individually in the form except for beneficial-owner disclosures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross turnover from wholesale sales of virgin polyethylene and polypropylene granules, invoiced in COP, before discounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All USD sales under SWIFT LC must be converted at the DIAN yearly average exchange rate; adjust gross income to reflect transfer-pricing corrections.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of polymer inventory, customs duties, freight-in, port charges, and LC bank fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support with bills of lading, invoices from overseas suppliers, and customs declarations; TP master and local file must be available to substantiate margins.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, general, and administrative expenses: salaries, rent, logistics overhead, insurance, professional fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party service fees must comply with CUP or TNMM and be supported by OECD-compliant documentation; deviations from arm's length are adjusted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income after statutory additions and deductions, computed on entity-level taxable profits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compare to audited P&L; any unabsorbed tax losses carried from prior years must satisfy the 12-year carryforward rule and the relevant offset conditions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 35% on Line 95; prior-year prepayments and DIAN withholding credits are applied on later lines.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign parent should reconcile effective cash tax to 35%; dividend WHT is computed separately on distribution, not in this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 112 (Total impuesto a cargo y saldo a pagar)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance payable after tax credits (ICA municipal tax deduction, withholding credits, prepayments).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure wire transfer is ordered using DIAN reference number to avoid default-interest charges.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of tax due per month or fraction, capped at 100% of the tax; if no tax due, penalty equals 1% of gross income subject to caps in UVT; late payment triggers default interest at DIAN prescribed annual rate (approximately 20-28%).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders from profits already taxed at corporate level; 15% if distributed from earnings not previously taxed (source wages or untaxed income); treaty reductions may lower 10% to 5%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Beneficial-owner non-resident shareholders must submit a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority and a statement of no Permanent Establishment in Colombia to the Colombian payer before the dividend payment; the reduced rate is applied at source only if the TRC is filed with DIAN and the payer maintains it in statutory records; otherwise excess WHT can be reclaimed through annual income tax return or refund procedure (Form 140 / extranet DIAN).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 35% statutory WHT (treaty-reduced to 10%-15% under DTAs). Interest: 15% statutory WHT (reduced to 5%-10% under certain DTAs); interest paid to related parties in tax-haven jurisdictions is subject to a 35% WHT as a deemed distribution under Colombian transfer-pricing rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: COP 4,706,500,000 (100,000 UVT for tax year 2024) in gross income or gross assets; transactions with entities in preferential tax regimes (tax-haven blacklist) trigger mandatory full TP documentation irrespective of value.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations; however, corporate tax residence is based on incorporation or effective management in Colombia, and the General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR, ET Art. 869) empowers DIAN to recharacterize shell arrangements lacking real local office, personnel, storage, and decision-making in metal/polymer wholesale trading; financial indicators must reflect actual economic activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion by Underreporting Gross Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling bulk polyethylene/polypropylene granules via foreign shell payment collection entities or issuing dual invoices, reducing Colombian taxable revenue while using irrevocable LC proceeds offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN correction: liquidación oficial with sanctions for inaccuracy of 100% of omitted tax; criminal evasion penalties under Colombia Criminal Law for amounts above 200 UVT: imprisonment from 4 to 9 years and fine of up to 60% of evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives can face criminal fraud and tax-evasion charges; a court may pierce the veil when the S.A.S. is a mere conduit, imposing civil restitution and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling polymer inventory to a related trader in Hong Kong or Singapore below arm's-length CIF margin to shift taxable profits offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Mandatory TP adjustment: additional tax plus penalty of 100% of the untaxed excess margin, annually; DIAN can ignore invoices from related providers without TP documentation; reiterative penalties for omission of supporting Form 120.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: CFO and tax manager personally liable for negligent signing of false certification under ET Art. 571; criminal liability for document falsification; disqualification to manage corporate affairs in Colombia.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Trade-Based Money Laundering and AML Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Over-valuing LC shipments of petrochemical polymers (e.g., inflated usance LC invoices) or generating offsetting fake deliveries to launder funds through the S.A.S. bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: UIAF (Financial Intelligence Unit) sanctions: fine up to 1,000× minimum monthly wage applicable; criminal anti-money-laundering law (Art. 323) imposes imprisonment of 8 to 15 years and fines of 100-1,000 minimum wages; exclusion from banking and trade corridors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Banking and AML legal framework holds the legal representative and beneficial shareholders personally accountable; travel bans, asset freezing, and up to 20 years of incarceration for organized crime involvement in bulk LC fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Dividend WHT Evasion and Artificial Loan Surrogation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Repatriating profits by classifying dividends as deductible interest, management fees, or reimbursement of fictitious prepurchase payments to avoid 10% dividend WHT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN recharacterization as dividends: additional 10%-15% WHT plus 5% per month late payment penalty up to 200% of the unwithheld tax; disallowance of the deductible payment and refusal to admit the DTA when no TRC is present.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The S.A.S. becomes jointly liable for withheld but unremitted amounts; directors can be personally obligated to pay the corporation's tax debt when they actively use corporate assets for personal benefit; criminal conviction for fraudulent retention up to 5 years, plus prohibition from serving as corporate director in Colombia.
